page.title: Transparency
page.subtitle: How we verify cases, who moderates, and how we guarantee data integrity

sources.title: Verified sources
sources.body: Every case published on the map has at least one verifiable public source: a news article, an official report, or a record from a recognized organization. Full sources are shown on each case page.

moderation.title: Moderation process
moderation.body: Each case is reviewed by three independent moderators before approval. If two out of three moderators vote in favor, the case is published. If a moderator detects an error, the case is rejected and the reporter receives a notification.

bias.title: Bias and limitations
bias.body: This map does not claim to be an exhaustive record. We depend on public sources and voluntary reports. Some countries have more coverage simply because they have more free press and organizations documenting these cases. The absence of a case does not mean it did not occur.

report.title: Annual report
report.body: We will soon publish an annual report with consolidated statistics, trends, and public policy recommendations.
